item.tib: zab don yid nor bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgrub gzhung don yod nyer bsdus zhags pa
item.coloph: rgyud phyag 'di'ang tshe dbang 'gyur med ming pas bris pa dge'o// zhes bsam lhun sgrab gzhung 'di'ang nyag bon gang rgyal bya btang bla brang rus skyes tshe dbang 'gyur med byang chub rol pa rtsal zhes 'bod pas shing pho khyi'i lo nang mdo smad rgyal mo rong gnas 'brel skabs g.yag ra dgon zhes pa'i gnas su sgrub gnas dang bla mtsho mjal dus Dak+ki mtsho rgyal mjal snang dang / gnas ni zangs mdog dpal ri (mtsho) ni mkha' 'gro'i bla mtsho yin pa'i gsal snang dang / gter srung ye shes dbal mo'i zab don brda' yi dbang bskur thob nas/ slar rang yul rmya rgyal lha phyug mdun du gter srung gis brda' bkrol ba'i lung gis bskul ba dang chabs cig tu/ rgyal bzang mchog sprul 'chi med/ dbal khyung mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin/ drang srong mchog rgyal/ stod gangs ri nas yang ston bla brgyud bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ sgrub sde ba bla ma gsum sogs nas bskul bzhin gang shar rig pa'i brda las phab pas dge gyur cig/
